note.question: How do online learning and optimization interact for revenue management problems with add-on discounts?
note.overview: This paper studies in this paper a revenue-management problem with add-on discounts. The problem is motivated by the practice in the video game industry by which a retailer offers discounts on selected supportive products (e.g., video games) to customers who have also purchased the core products (e.g., video game consoles). The paper formulates this problem as an optimization problem to determine the prices of different products and the selection of products for add-on discounts.
